description: This file defines core service management classes and interfaces for a plugin or service architecture, including ServiceAdministrator, Service and Sink types, and registration macros.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing the lifecycle of services, libraries, and callbacks.

classes.name: SinkType
classes.description: Template class implementing reference counting for sink objects.

classes.name: ServiceType
classes.description: Template class managing service instances, including library locking and reference counting.

classes.name: PublishedServiceType
classes.description: Template class for registering and creating published services with metadata.

classes.name: IService
classes.description: Interface for service objects, including metadata and query interface support.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing version and identification info for services.

classes.name: IUnknown
classes.description: Base interface for COM-like query interface support.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets the callback object for service administrator.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the service administrator.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and possibly triggers cleanup.

methods.name: Instances
methods.description: Returns the current number of instances.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service or interface from a library.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service interface.

methods.name: LockLibrary
methods.description: Associates a library with a service.

methods.name: Destructed
methods.description: Called before object destruction to release resources.
